Catalog geometry for a compound-anchored head

Source: R/heads.R
compound_head_geometry.Rd

Collects each compound's position on the H x W canvas, expressed as a fraction in the same convention as the head's token centres (pixel p sits at (p - 0.5) / H), and a positional spread used as the width of the head's location prior. Positions come from catalog_pixel_positions(), which maps every observation onto the canvas the way pad_to_target() centre-pads real samples, so the prior is centred where the peak sits in both synthetic and real images. The spread is the SD of the observations' canvas positions combined with any extra displacement the pretraining augmentation can introduce (affine shift, RT warp), so the prior stays wide enough to find a shifted peak. (The head additionally floors the width at one feature-map cell.)

Usage

compound_head_geometry(
  catalog,
  H,
  W,
  compound_ids = NULL,
  extra_rt_px = 0,
  extra_cv_px = 0
)

Arguments

catalog

A peak_catalog.

H, W

Image dimensions in pixels.

compound_ids

Optional subset of compound_ids. Default: every compound with a finite position.

extra_rt_px, extra_cv_px

Additional displacement (pixels) to fold into the prior width, e.g. the maximum affine shift.

Value

List with compound_id, rt_frac, cv_frac, sd_rt_frac, sd_cv_frac, all as fractions of H / W.
